_readme: Everything editable lives here. Nothing in src/ needs touching for routine updates. Product names, prices, links and images are NOT stored here: they come live from Gumroad at render time.

brand.name: theMoBader
brand.creator: Mohammad Bader
brand.tagline: تعلّم. ابنِ. طوّر. حوّل مهاراتك إلى قيمة.

social._note: Leave a value empty to hide that link. Only add URLs you have verified. They open in a new tab.

featured._note: Which catalogue products fill the two featured cards. 'permalink' (the last part of the product URL) pins a product exactly. If empty, the page matches by name. A card with no match stays hidden, and the product still appears under the other products.

historicalResults._note: Supplied by Mohammad. Confirm both figures are still accurate before publishing. Set show to false to hide the block. They are framed as past results, never as a guarantee.

_testimonialsNote: Real quotes only. Each item needs a quote and a name, and may add a context and a result. When the list is empty, no testimonial UI is rendered.
